remarks: This beautifully updated condominium, set within a restored Victorian home, blends timeless architectural character with modern luxury in a premier downtown location. The residence offers 4 bedrooms and 3.1 baths, plus a gourmet kitchen with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances. A spacious wraparound porch extends the living space outdoors, complemented by a rare front and side yard. Parking includes a two-car garage and two additional spaces. The lower level features a 2,000-bottle wine cellar and abundant storage. Located in an intimate seven-residence boutique community, it offers exceptional privacy and refined downtown living.
